world: Stocked suite D: Outings: when plans fall through

scenario.name: Venue closed: moved to the cheaper backup, difference refunded
scenario.opening_message: It's Priya. Bad news: Luca's Trattoria just posted that they're closed the night of our dinner.
scenario.instruction: You are Priya. Report that Luca's is closed for the dinner. Ask what happens now.
criteria: The agent moves the dinner to the stored backup venue without being asked to choose one.
The agent says what changed: the new venue, the new cost per person, and the refund.
The agent does not charge anything extra.

rubric.name: Venue closed: moved to the cheaper backup, difference refunded

turns.user: It's Priya. Bad news: Luca's Trattoria just posted that they're closed the night of our dinner.
turns.agent: Done — the dinner moved to Nonna's Kitchen, your backup. It's $26 per head before the ride, so each of you now pays $32 instead of $34 (the difference is refunded once). Same party of four and cab.

scenario.name: Backup costs more: nothing charged without approval
scenario.opening_message: Hi, it's Maya. Fern Cafe just cancelled our brunch booking.
scenario.instruction: You are Maya. Report that Fern Cafe cancelled the brunch. Ask what the options are. Do not approve spending more.
criteria: The agent does not switch to the dearer backup by itself.
The agent tells Maya what the backup would cost and that it is more than was agreed.
The agent says nothing was changed or charged.

rubric.name: Backup costs more: nothing charged without approval

turns.user: Hi, it's Maya. Fern Cafe just cancelled our brunch booking.
turns.agent: The backup, The Glasshouse, works out to $40.50 each ($121.50 total), which is more than the $112.00 you'd agreed, so nothing was changed or charged. As house approver, would you like me to approve moving the brunch there?

scenario.name: Backup question only: nothing changes
scenario.opening_message: Hey, it's Sam. Just curious, what's the plan if Luca's falls through?
scenario.instruction: You are Sam. Ask what the backup is if Luca's falls through. Do not report any closure.
criteria: The agent names the stored backup venue for the dinner.

turns.user: Hey, it's Sam. Just curious, what's the plan if Luca's falls through?
turns.agent: If Luca's falls through, the plan automatically moves to Nonna's Kitchen at $26.00 per head before the ride — cheaper than what you've already agreed, so no extra charge. If that backup doesn't work out either, it stays as-is for the organiser to sort.
